data.one_liner: Flutter package to use Arabic fonts from Google and arbfonts in text widgets
data.what_it_does: Provides ArabicTextStyle and ArabicThemeData to apply Arabic fonts to individual Text widgets or the whole app. Supports 24 fonts bundled as assets.
use_when: You need Arabic fonts in a Flutter app
You want to switch fonts globally or per widget
You prefer a simple API without code generation
avoid_when: You need dynamic font loading from network
You require advanced text shaping beyond basic font selection
strengths: Supports multiple fonts out of the box
Works on all platforms (Android, iOS, Web, Desktop)
weaknesses: No support for custom font files at runtime
data.setup_notes: Add arabic_font to dependencies and run flutter pub get
data.minimal_example:
import 'package:arabic_font/arabic_font.dart';
Text('تجربة الخط', style: ArabicTextStyle(arabicFont: ArabicFont.dubai, fontSize:25));
